newsitem.title: GERMANY: German labour office sees construction jobs down.
newsitem.headline: German labour office sees construction jobs down.

text.p: The German labour office said it expects a small fall in employment in the German construction sector in the fourth quarter of 1996.

Labour office researcher Hanspeter Leikeb told a news conference on the September unemployment data, "From June to September we saw the positive effects in the construction sector of the recovery due to seasonal factors. But at the end of the year I expect we will see a fall."
In manufacturing, Leikeb said, "We have seen a clear fall (in employment) because of the slowness of economic recovery. That (fall) is slowing down, but has not yet translated into an increase."
Germany has seen clear growth in the services sector, however, he said. The sector has been growing strongly.
